goal: Resolve the six semantic concepts required by CML-07 before identity Artifact Type construction.

preserve stable CAV2 IDs where an owned source Definition exists

The pack, records, and validation grant no admission, promotion, implementation, or publication effect.

claim_ceiling: A structurally validated Define candidate for the six CML-07 concepts. It does not accept the pack, admit sources or owners, promote definitions, make S2 evaluable, construct carriers, implement, publish, release, or deploy.
